description: Figure 5 is a pie chart illustrating the matching statistics for Persona 6, displaying the distribution of counts across several categories. The chart contains eight slices, representing “clean water,” “basic healthcare,” “public transport,” “emergency services,” “transit subsidies,” “DV victims,” “AIDS victims,” and “drug victims.” The slices are colored in shades of blue and purple. The “clean water” slice is the largest, representing approximately 87% of the total, followed by “basic healthcare” at roughly 85%. “Public transport” accounts for approximately 82%, while “emergency services” is around 76%. “Transit subsidies” represents about 69%, “DV victims” is approximately 65%, “AIDS victims” is around 60%, and “drug victims” comprises approximately 55% of the chart. Percentage labels are included inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise by descending size. A legend is present, listing each category and its corresponding color.
